notes:
Script completed: set -eu
BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)
NUM=$(gh pr list --head $BRANCH --state open --limit 1 --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
if [ -z "$NUM" ]; then
  MERGED=$(gh pr list --head $BRANCH --state merged --limit 1 --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
  if [ -n "$MERGED" ]; then
    echo "PR #$MERGED is merged; ending the workflow."
    echo '{"preferred_next_label": "merged", "context_updates": {"pr_state": "merged"}}'
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "no open or merged pull request for branch $BRANCH" >&2
  exit 1
fi
STATE=$(gh pr view $NUM --json state --jq .state)
if [ "$STATE" = MERGED ]; then
  echo "PR #$NUM is merged; ending the workflow."
  echo '{"preferred_next_label": "merged", "context_updates": {"pr_state": "merged"}}'
  exit 0
fi
if [ "$STATE" = CLOSED ]; then
  echo "PR #$NUM was closed without merging; ending the workflow."
  echo '{"preferred_next_label": "closed", "context_updates": {"pr_state": "closed"}}'
  exit 0
fi
SINCE=$(cat /tmp/pr-feedback-since.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
NEW=/tmp/pr-new-comments.jsonl
: > $NEW
gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/$NUM/comments" --paginate | jq -c --arg since "$SINCE" '.[] | select((.body // "") != "") | select(.created_at > $since) | {at: .created_at, author: .user.login, where: "conversation", body: .body}' >> $NEW
gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/$NUM/comments" --paginate | jq -c --arg since "$SINCE" '.[] | select((.body // "") != "") | select(.created_at > $since) | {at: .created_at, author: .user.login, where: ((.path // "file") + ":" + ((.line // .original_line // 0) | tostring)), body: .body}' >> $NEW
gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/$NUM/reviews" --paginate | jq -c --arg since "$SINCE" '.[] | select(((.body // "") != "") or .state == "CHANGES_REQUESTED") | select((.submitted_at // "") > $since) | {at: .submitted_at, author: .user.login, where: ("review " + .state), body: (if (.body // "") == "" then "(no body; changes requested)" else .body end)}' >> $NEW
echo $NOW > /tmp/pr-feedback-since.txt
if [ ! -s $NEW ]; then
  echo "PR #$NUM is open with no new comments since $SINCE."
  echo '{"preferred_next_label": "quiet", "context_updates": {"pr_state": "quiet"}}'
  exit 0
fi
jq -rs 'sort_by(.at) | .[] | ("### " + .author + " - " + .where + " - " + .at), "", .body, ""' $NEW > /tmp/pr-comments.md
COUNT=$(jq -s length $NEW)
echo "PR #$NUM has $COUNT new comment(s) since $SINCE; written to /tmp/pr-comments.md"
echo '{"preferred_next_label": "comments", "context_updates": {"pr_state": "comments"}}'
